text.content:
An athlete who picked up a gun.

Role: Solo
Affiliation: Maine's crew
Known for: Hating the Animals and the Voodoo Boys

Spoilers for Cyberpunk: Edgerunners. Raised in Iceland by athletes, Dorio came to Night City for a meet. Her father joined the Animals' fight circuit and died in crossfire between the Animals and the Voodoo Boys. Maine found her stalking an Animal and asked her to join his crew.

Edgerunner's Handbook (Edgerunners Mission Kit), p.36
